product_overview: VidoPRO is an Android-only, dark-themed video editor for fast social editing with a smooth timeline, real-time preview, and reliable MP4 export. It is designed to support beginner-friendly creation now while scaling toward advanced motion graphics and keyframe-based editing later.
core_goals: Enable users to create and manage local video editing projects quickly
Provide a smooth, responsive multi-track timeline with trim, split, delete, duplicate, and move actions
Support import of video, image, and audio media from device storage
Deliver stable preview playback that stays synchronized with the timeline playhead
Provide reliable autosave, undo/redo, and project restoration
Export edited projects as MP4 files through a background pipeline with progress and cancellation
Maintain a polished dark Material 3 UI optimized for mobile usability and performance

features.name: Project Management
features.description: Users can create, view, rename, duplicate, and delete local editing projects, with recent projects shown first and project metadata stored for restoration.
user_flows: POST create project via local repository with name and aspect ratio -> Receive saved project with default metadata -> GET project list -> Receive recent projects ordered by updatedAt
POST create project with empty name -> Receive project with default name and timestamps -> DELETE project by id -> Receive success and updated project list
GET project by invalid id -> Receive null or not found state -> Show friendly error state in UI

features.name: Media Import and Asset Handling
features.description: Users can import local video, image, and audio media, with metadata extraction, thumbnail caching, and asset persistence for use on the timeline.
user_flows: POST import media URI -> Read metadata and persist asset -> Create clip from imported asset -> Return asset and clip ready for timeline insertion
POST import unsupported file URI -> Metadata reader fails -> Receive friendly import error state and no clip is created
POST import media URI with missing file -> Asset lookup fails during validation -> Receive missing media error and block clip creation

features.name: Timeline Engine
features.description: Users can edit clips on a deterministic timeline with playhead control, zoom, snapping, duration recalculation, and undo-friendly state updates.
user_flows: POST add clip to track with start time and duration -> Reducer returns updated timeline state -> GET current timeline state -> Receive clip placed on the correct track and project duration recalculated
POST move clip with valid new start time -> Reducer updates clip position -> GET timeline state -> Receive clamped position if needed and updated project duration
POST trim clip start or end beyond valid bounds -> Reducer rejects or clamps action -> Receive unchanged or corrected timeline state with validation-safe duration
POST split clip at playhead when playhead is within clip bounds -> Reducer creates two clips -> GET timeline state -> Receive two valid clips with correct source in/out points
POST delete clip by id -> Reducer removes clip and clears selection if needed -> GET timeline state -> Receive updated project duration and no deleted clip
POST duplicate clip by id -> Reducer creates new clip with new id -> GET timeline state -> Receive duplicate placed after original and selected if supported
POST seek playhead to negative or beyond duration -> Reducer clamps playhead -> GET timeline state -> Receive safe playhead value within valid range

features.name: Clip Editing Actions
features.description: Users can perform basic editing actions such as trimming, splitting, deleting, duplicating, and moving clips from the editor UI.
user_flows: POST trim clip start -> Reducer updates inPointMs, startTimeMs, and durationMs -> GET clip state -> Receive shortened clip with minimum duration preserved
POST trim clip end -> Reducer updates outPointMs and durationMs -> GET clip state -> Receive adjusted clip end without negative duration
POST delete selected clip -> Reducer removes clip -> GET selected clip state -> Receive cleared selection and updated timeline
POST duplicate selected clip -> Reducer copies clip with new id -> GET timeline state -> Receive duplicate clip and selection updated if applicable
POST split clip at playhead near clip boundary -> Reducer validates boundary -> Receive no-op when split would violate minimum duration or boundary rules

features.name: Real-time Preview Playback
features.description: Users can play, pause, and seek synchronized preview playback with the current timeline position reflected in the editor.
user_flows: GET preview playback state -> Receive current time and play/pause state -> POST play command -> Receive playback starts and playhead updates through observed state
POST seek preview to timeline time -> Player seeks to requested position -> GET playback state -> Receive updated current time matching playhead
POST pause playback -> Player pauses -> GET playback state -> Receive paused state with preserved current time
GET active clip at current time -> Receive active video/image/text layers for preview composition
POST seek to invalid time value -> Controller clamps to valid range -> Receive safe playback position without crash

features.name: Text Layers
features.description: Users can add and edit text clips with style controls, duration, and timeline placement for overlaying text on videos.
user_flows: POST create text clip with text content and style -> Save text clip data -> GET timeline state -> Receive text clip on text track or overlay track
POST update text clip content -> Persist updated text data -> GET text clip -> Receive revised content and style metadata
POST add text clip with missing text content -> Validation fails -> Receive friendly error and no clip is created

features.name: Basic Filters and Effects
features.description: Users can apply clip-level visual adjustments such as brightness, contrast, saturation, and exposure, with settings stored for preview and export.
user_flows: POST update effect parameters for a clip -> Persist effect entity -> GET clip effects -> Receive updated brightness, contrast, saturation, or exposure values
POST set invalid effect value outside supported range -> Validation rejects request -> Receive error state and preserve previous values
POST reset effects for clip -> Replace effect parameters with defaults -> GET clip effects -> Receive default values restored

features.name: Transitions
features.description: Users can define transitions between adjacent clips with supported types such as fade, slide, zoom, and wipe, while respecting overlap and duration rules.
user_flows: POST create transition between two clips -> Save transition entity -> GET transitions for track -> Receive stored transition with duration and type
POST create transition with invalid overlap or duration -> Validation rejects transition -> Receive error state and no transition saved
DELETE transition by id -> Remove transition entity -> GET track transitions -> Receive transition no longer present

features.name: Autosave and Undo/Redo
features.description: Users get automatic project saving with debounced writes and can undo or redo supported timeline and editing actions.
user_flows: POST editing action such as move, trim, split, or delete -> Update state and queue autosave -> PUT project after debounce -> Receive saved project and updated timestamp
POST undo command -> Restore previous immutable editor state -> GET editor state -> Receive prior clip positions or trim values restored
POST redo command after undo -> Reapply last reverted action -> GET editor state -> Receive action reapplied and redo stack updated
POST save while project is invalid or missing media -> Validation or repository save fails -> Receive error state without losing existing project data

features.name: Project Persistence
features.description: Users can save and restore projects locally with Room-backed relational storage for projects, tracks, clips, assets, effects, keyframes, text clips, and transitions.
user_flows: GET project with tracks by id -> Load relational data from Room -> Receive full project graph with tracks and clips restored
POST update project graph -> Run transaction save to Room -> Receive durable local save with updated timestamp
DELETE project by id -> Cascade delete tracks, clips, effects, keyframes, and related entities -> GET project by id -> Receive not found state
GET project list -> Observe projects ordered by updatedAt desc -> Receive latest local projects for home screen

features.name: Project Export
features.description: Users can export edited projects to MP4 in the background with progress reporting, cancellation, validation, and gallery saving.
user_flows: POST export request with valid project and settings -> Validate project -> Enqueue WorkManager export -> Receive progress updates and final MediaStore URI on success
POST export request with empty project -> Validation fails -> Receive blocked export and friendly empty-project error
POST export request with missing media -> Validation fails -> Receive missing-media error and no output file is created
POST cancel export while worker is running -> Worker stops and cleans temp file -> GET export state -> Receive cancelled state and no incomplete gallery file
POST export with unsupported resolution or invalid settings -> Validation fails -> Receive error state before encoding starts

code_summary.description: Advanced Android Video Editor with multi-track timeline, real-time compositor, keyframe animations, video transitions, effects, and export pipeline.

modules.core:model: Domain models: Clip, Track, Project, Keyframe, Effect, Transition, Transform

modules.core:database: Room Database, DAOs, Entities, and Type Converters

modules.core:data: Repository implementations, mappers, and data sources

modules.core:media: Media3 player, transformer exporter, compositing layers, and keyframe evaluator

modules.core:ui: Design system tokens, typography, shapes, and reusable UI components

modules.feature:timeline: Timeline engine, reducer, history, tracks, and UI composables

modules.feature:editor: Main editor screen, tools bottom sheets, and preview canvas

features.name: Timeline Engine
features.description: Pure unidirectional state reducer for managing multi-track clips, transitions, and timeline actions with full undo/redo history.

features.name: Keyframe Animation System
features.description: Multi-property keyframe interpolation (Linear, Hold, Ease-In, Ease-Out, Ease-In-Out, Bezier) for transform, effects, opacity, and masks.

features.name: Real-time Video Preview
features.description: Synchronized ExoPlayer playback with dynamic layer compositing and Compose Canvas overlays.

features.name: Video Transitions
features.description: Centered boundary transitions including Fade, Slide, Zoom, and Wipe across video clips with deterministic progress.

features.name: Visual Effects and Masks
features.description: Color matrix adjustments (Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Exposure, Highlights, Shadows), geometric masks, and Porter-Duff blend modes.

features.name: Project Exporter
features.description: Media3 Transformer pipeline rendering composition layers, shader effects, and transitions into production MP4 files.

features.name: Project Persistence
features.description: Full Room database relational storage for projects, tracks, clips, keyframes, transitions, and effects.
